exclusion_reason: Bounded D3D11 signal and live WebGPU capability can be observed, but D3D9, DXGI, DXBC, resource, shader, synchronization, and cross-browser behavior are unimplemented.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-025 prototype and feature-gap report cover DXGI, D3D10/11, DXBC, resource, synchronization, shader, WebGPU limit, and performance.
expected_failing_assertion: No measured D3D10/11-to-WebGPU path meets correctness and performance criteria.
active_gate_evidence: The product reports bounded DXGI, D3D11, and DXBC signal plus live ephemeral WebGPU capability, then returns defer without a support claim.
procedure: Map required API and shader behavior to current WebGPU and prototype the highest-risk gap.
Compare against DXVK behavior while recording every browser abstraction mismatch.
pass_criterion: The report is backed by a reproducible prototype and complete gap matrix.
It recommends a bounded implementation item or a documented defer or rejection.
